scientific_scope_status: For E_U(rho)=U(rho tensor I_r/r)U*,integer r>=2,p=1,Delta=0,0<zeta<1, bounded definite-causal adaptive PHYSICAL queries obey half-distance<=1-(1-1/r)^n and require Omega(r log(1/zeta)) for uniform inverse error zeta. IID FULL-CHOI programs have a stronger quadratic-rank lower and matched consumed upper. The all-real-p rank-r orthogonal-reset subclass requires n>=9r²/(32768p²) Choi copies at complete error<=p/4. Fresh classically specified repreparable probes inherit quadratic exponents through an explicit retry reduction; coherent queries entangled with retained UNKNOWN memory do not.
